decision.interpretation: The RMS continuous-node variance-only correction is the selected research candidate with the lowest completed canonical52 score (0.5957716608071159): 0.1755% better than deterministic RMS, 1.2497% better than rough-off and 2.9482% better than M261. Its hooked runtime adapter matches the complete daily paths and saved winner CRPS vectors on all 2,652 original contexts, with calendars and hooks restored. In six predetermined local compute contexts, its measured medians are faster than production and rough-off for both fresh and cached fits, and essentially tied with the separate RMSruntime implementation. These are not an all52 timing average or website click-to-visible evidence, so no universal or live speed claim is made. Historical80 scores remain unrun for all refinements except the distinct rough-off control. No candidate is registered for production.

entries.methodology: Disable only the rough output multiplier; fitted curves, means, shocks, training fits, seeds and accounting remain unchanged. The diagnostic runner still computes rough internals, so its cached per-variant timings are not a fair speed comparison.
entries.name: Rough multiplier removed

historical80.implementation: optimized native rough bypass; 2,106 validated legacy origins preserved and 1,974 computed after handoff

entries.methodology: Retain the rough process, fitted parameters and random draws; normalize with the exact conditional Gaussian rough mean and covariance at each future day. Existing fitted persistence governs future covariance evolution.
entries.name: Conditional rough normalization

entries.methodology: Retain the rough process, fitted parameters and random draws; normalize with exact conditional Gaussian rough moments and scale toward the training-fitted EWMA variance path. Existing fitted persistence governs rough covariance evolution.
entries.name: Conditional rough normalization with EWMA variance targeting

entries.methodology: Use conditional rough normalization while disabling the conventional stochastic volatility multiplier.
entries.name: Conditional rough normalization without the conventional stochastic multiplier

entries.methodology: Use the fitted terminal rough-state posterior mean and covariance as the conditional forecast anchor, propagate them with existing fitted persistence, and retain the training-derived conventional-state configuration.
entries.name: Conditional rough latent-state anchor

entries.methodology: Add one zero-centered constant daily log-growth error per forecast path. Its variance is the unchanged training-fit HAC long-run return variance divided by training length; antithetic draws preserve the daily ensemble mean. No horizon cutoff or score-fitted weight is used.
entries.name: Permanent training-estimated growth uncertainty

entries.methodology: Add a mean-reverting growth-state error using training-fitted persistence and innovation variance, initialized at the fitted posterior variance. The point forecast stays unchanged; permanent HAC drift is not added.
entries.name: Training-fitted mean-reverting growth uncertainty

entries.methodology: Set the future conventional multiplier to sqrt(E[M_t^2|training])=1. Retain the unchanged fitted mean and return-variance curves, empirical residual nodes, dependence uniforms, seeds, clipping, and accounting. This exactly reproduces the existing neither-multiplier ablation; it is not a new normalization correction.
entries.name: Deterministic RMS multiplier (existing neither-multiplier ablation)

entries.methodology: Set M_t=E[M_t|training]=exp(-conditional_variance_t/8) from the fitted conditional Gaussian moments while retaining the same mean curve, fit, return-variance curve, empirical residual nodes, dependence uniforms, clipping, and accounting. This changes the forecast distribution; it does not preserve its tails or expectation after clipping and accounting.
entries.name: Conditional-mean conventional multiplier

entries.methodology: Replace the deterministic-RMS candidate's return-standard-deviation curve with the original formula's conditional moment curve. Keep its original mean, Student-return Laplace empirical nodes, dependence uniforms, calendar, clipping and policy-aware accounting. Coupled QMLE and future conventional-SV simulation are omitted; two numerical fits remain (the predecessor fastMAP fit and Student-return Laplace refit), so this is not a one-fit variant.
entries.name: Original-moment return-dispersion curve

validation.numerical_fit_count: two; predecessor fastMAP and Student-return Laplace

entries.methodology: At every future day, replace the volatility-scaled M261 daily log-return location with the asset's arithmetic training log-return mean at both empirical-node mapping and native conventional centering. Keep the M261 return-standard-deviation curve byte-for-byte, including its existing location-related variance contribution, and retain fitted laws, empirical nodes, dependence, RNG streams, seeds, clipping, and accounting. No held-out data fit, asset-specific rule, or horizon tuning is introduced.
entries.name: Constant raw training log-mean location with fixed dispersion

validation.timing_qualification: mixed first-use/cache states and instrumented correctness cases; not a matched speed claim

entries.methodology: The attempted process was analytically identical because its upstream predecessor fit fixed_mean=True, forcing the initial state and innovation variance to zero.
entries.name: Coherent mean-reverting growth uncertainty identity control

entries.methodology: Apply the analytic continuous-uniform mean and variance correction to the same piecewise-linear empirical quantile-node distribution used by rough-off. Keep fitted laws, dependence, seeds, clipping and accounting fixed. The correction is made before clipping and accounting, so it is not a claim of exact post-clip moments or conditional-copula uniformity.
entries.name: Continuous-uniform moment correction on rough-off

validation.timing_qualification: ordered methodology study, reused fits and instrumented correctness cases; not matched runtime or website CTV

entries.methodology: Apply the analytic continuous-uniform mean and variance correction to the same piecewise-linear empirical quantile-node distribution used by deterministic RMS. Keep fitted laws, dependence, seeds, clipping and accounting fixed. The correction is made before clipping and accounting, so it is not a claim of exact post-clip moments or conditional-copula uniformity.
entries.name: Continuous-uniform moment correction on deterministic RMS

validation.timing_qualification: ordered methodology study, reused fits and instrumented correctness cases; not matched runtime or website CTV

entries.methodology: Add the training-filtered terminal mean-state deviation to the unchanged M261/RMS point curve with its fitted AR(1) fade. Keep original return dispersion, empirical quantile nodes, dependence uniforms, seeds and accounting unchanged.
entries.name: History-conditioned state-mean correction

validation.timing_qualification: reused saved history-fit metadata with runtime oracle; not fresh-fit performance or CTV

entries.methodology: Add the training-filtered terminal mean-state deviation and an independent coherent antithetic AR(1) state-error path initialized from fitted terminal posterior variance and innovation variance. Keep the original point curve, return dispersion, empirical quantile nodes, dependence uniforms, seeds and accounting unchanged.
entries.name: History-conditioned state-mean correction and uncertainty

validation.timing_qualification: reused saved history-fit metadata with runtime oracle; not fresh-fit performance or CTV

entries.methodology: Retain the original-moment return-dispersion curve, mean, fitted laws and dependence, and apply the analytic continuous-uniform mean and variance correction to its piecewise-linear empirical quantile-node distribution before clipping. This is a parent-by-correction factorial cell; it does not claim exact post-clip moments or conditional-copula uniformity.
entries.name: Original-moment variance with continuous-node moment correction

validation.checkpoint_to_cell_independent_rebuild: passed byte-exact for all five cells
validation.timing_qualification: ordered methodology study, reused fits and instrumented correctness cases; not matched runtime or website CTV

entries.methodology: For the empirical inverse-CDF node curve, retain its continuous mean and scale only its centered spread to unit continuous variance before the existing clipping step. The analytic target is verified at every origin; this does not claim exact post-clip moments or conditional-copula uniformity.
entries.name: RMS with continuous-node variance correction preserving mean

runtime_full_panel_parity.independent_audit_scope: independent all2652 receipt/source/context and saved-CRPS-hash audit; no forecast replay
runtime_full_panel_parity.scope: all-work exact runtime parity; no speed or CTV claim

runtime_selected_context_parity.qualification: prespecified-context exact parity only; no runtime/CTV claim

entries.methodology: Retain deterministic RMS mean and return-dispersion curves, empirical residual nodes, seeds and accounting. Replace IID dependence uniforms with chronological stationary bootstrap row indices selected from training-only maximum Politis–White lengths for standardized residuals and their squares; randomized rank intervals handle ties.
entries.name: RMS with stationary residual-rank resampling

validation.path_storage: full daily path arrays not retained; exact full-horizon losses, daily summaries, full-path hashes, terminal tails and growth records retained per origin

entries.methodology: Combine the same stationary residual-rank resampling with the analytic continuous-uniform mean and variance correction applied before clipping. The RMS curves, seeds and accounting stay fixed; no exact post-clip moment or conditional-copula claim is made.

entries.methodology: Keep the original mapped point mean and empirical nodes, while using the already fitted direct-Student posterior mean and terminal Laplace variance law for volatility. Preserve the original seeds, dependence uniforms, clipping, calendar and rejoin.

entries.methodology: Use the direct-Student posterior mean and terminal Laplace variance law together for the planned latent Gaussian moments, retaining original empirical nodes, seeds, dependence uniforms, clipping, calendar and rejoin.
entries.name: Coherent direct-Student mean and variance

entries.methodology: Use the current-coupled volatility variance with its coherent implied mean, retaining original empirical nodes, seeds, dependence uniforms, clipping, calendar and rejoin. This is a completed comparison control, not a new fit.
entries.name: Coherent current-coupled mean and variance
